newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 16.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd and Swiss Bank Corp announce tie-up agreement.
-- Toyota Motor Corp plans to start joint venture in Russia.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) considers cut in corporate tax by 2.5 percentage points.
-- Eight Japanese tourists killed in bus crash in Spain.
-- Securities watchdog recommends punitive measures against Nomura Securities Co Ltd to prevent future payoff scandals.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda to discuss calling back Air Self-Defence Force planes sent to Thailand.
